name: Saritasa VR Product Display
summary: The purpose of this VR experience is to showcase the passenger drone of the future in an industrial setting. These modern 2-seater drones have pre-programmed flight plans and fast replacement batteries. The industrial location would be a typical waypoint where the Drones can quickly land and swap out a used power cell for a new one.
